title: Private Boston Crime Tour to Uncover the City's Dark Past
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Delve into Boston's shadowy history on this crime-themed walking tour. Led by an engaging local guide, explore sites like the Boston Massacre Site and South Boston Waterfront while hearing gripping tales of infamous mobsters and serial killers. This tour offers a unique perspective on Boston’s history, perfect for true crime enthusiasts and curious travelers alike. With a duration of approximately 2 hours and 20 minutes, this private tour is an intimate experience. The guide can also provide a "director's cut tour" if the guest would like, adding additional stops and stories not included in the public tour. 
- Discover Boston's notorious crime history through captivating stories
- Visit key sites including the Boston Massacre Site and South Boston Waterfront
- Ideal for true crime fans and those looking for a unique city experience
- Small group size ensures personalized attention from your knowledgeable guide
